title: Round 4b: DAgger with a larger student and a gentler teacher, three seeds
description: Round 4 (experiments/net2-r4-dagger.json, DAgger from a teacher that is the share rule while a stock TCP flow shares the link and the fixed rule otherwise) asks whether the student can tell a copy of itself from a buffer-filling competitor from net1's output alone. The gate's binding condition after round 3 is exactly that: the PPO residual on the share rule beat the rule with Cubic from the start and in the competition conditions but lost 0.34 as copies (exp-net2-gate-r3-111). Two changes that bear on it run here, on runners round 4 leaves idle: a student GRU of 128 units instead of 64, for more room to carry that inference over time, and teacher gain k = 0.5 (the share rule's validation choice, under which the PPO residual passed both competition families) next to k = 1. Otherwise as round 4: learning rate 1e-3, the competition mix, sigma = 0.05, seeds 1, 2 and 3, 60 iterations. The policies go to their own gate. Validation links only.
run: S="$OUT/spec-r4b-h128-k$K-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .hidden = 128 | .base = "fixed" | .share_k = $k | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 200 | .replay_iterations = 8 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r4b-h128-k$K-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
